title: Moving to Estero FL: The 2026 Complete Commute Guide
excerpt: Estero puts the airport, FGCU, two hospital systems, and the Gulf beaches within about 3 to 11 miles in a straight line, but which side of I-75 you live on and which road you depend on in season shape your daily drive more than the mileage. The new Three Oaks Parkway link, the Corkscrew Road widening, and I-75 express lanes all change the map in 2026 and 2027.
